name: alloc-leak
title: Allocation leak
fix_goal: Every pointer returned by p101_malloc or p101_realloc remains owned until p101_free releases it.
fix_steps: Find the allocation that survives to process exit.
Decide which scope owns the pointer.
Free it once in the common cleanup path.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the allocation-leak lab is fixed.
lesson: A heap allocation returned by p101_malloc remains owned until it is passed to p101_free.
